channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: City To Enforce 10 PM New Year’s Eve Curfew For Minors After Area Shootings
item.description: “We’re asking parents who may not be as diligent as most parents already are, to just know where their children are,” Mayor Brandon Johnson said.

item.title: Chicago Under Siege: How Operation Midway Blitz Changed Our City
item.description: Federal agents arrested thousands during an unprecedented immigration mission in Chicago. They also killed a man, shot a woman five times, tear-gassed a 1-year-old, separated families and brutalized people across the city, claiming it was all to make Chicago safe.

item.title: Chicago To Ring In New Year With Lake-Effect Snow And Cold Temps
item.description: Two “clipper systems” are expected to move across the Chicago area over the next two days, bringing a dusting of snow and slippery roads.

item.title: ‘Abolish ICE’ Snowplow Name Gets National Attention — And The Mayor’s Support
item.description: The Chicagoan who submitted the name has done so several times over the years, but thinks this could be the year it wins. "As a fourth-generation Mexican American, I am incredibly heartened by the response and support," he said.

item.title: 10 Things To Do Outside In Chicago This January
item.description: Start off the new year by savoring the last of the twinkling lights, going on an "owl prowl," ice-skating or supporting native ecosystems.

item.title: 14 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Your Last Chance For Holiday Events And More
item.description: You can also celebrate David Bowie at the Bowie Ball, check out a new headliner at the Magic Parlour and go to a Show & Tell For Grown-Ups at the International Museum of Surgical Science.

item.title: Humboldt Park Restaurant Owner’s Family Races To Stop His Deportation
item.description: Asif Amin Cheema, 63, could be deported unless an administrative appellate body votes to reopen his immigration case, which is pending an appeal with the Board of Immigration Appeals.

item.title: Block Club’s 10 Most Popular Arts & Culture Stories Of 2025
item.description: A self-described "terrible" artist drew crowds at local farmers markets. And was the mythical "man in the Bean" this year's rat hole?

item.title: How Block Club Stories Made An Impact In 2025
item.description: Our reporting spurred readers to donate their time, money — and for one reader, a kidney — to make a difference in neighborhoods across Chicago.

item.title: Trump Says He’s Taking National Guard Troops Out Of Chicago — For Now — After Court Defeat
item.description: The president vowed in a social media post that the Guard would return to Chicago while claiming that crime declined "ONLY" by having troops here — despite them never actually being mobilized.
